title: Two-factor login
subtitle: Protect your account with an authenticator app
loadFailed: Could not load your two-factor login status
genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
enterSixDigits: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
enterRecoveryCode: Enter one of your recovery codes
enabledSince: Turned on {{date}}. You will be asked for a code from your phone when you sign in.
explain: Besides your password, sign-in will also need a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy...).
recommendedOwner: Strongly recommended for pharmacy owners: your account controls sales, stock, staff and money.
recommendedAdmin: Strongly recommended for platform administrators: your account controls every pharmacy on the platform.
setupIntro: Confirm your password to start. Have your phone with an authenticator app ready.
scanStep1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
scanStep2: Scan the QR code, or type the setup key by hand.
scanStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enabledSuccess: Two-factor login is on. Keep your recovery codes safe.
disabledSuccess: Two-factor login has been turned off.
disableIntro: Turning this off makes your account easier to break into. Confirm with your password and a code.
regenerateIntro: Your old recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with your password and a code from the app.

recovery.warning: Save these recovery codes now. Each one works once, if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
recovery.savedConfirm: I have saved my recovery codes in a safe place
recovery.fileNote: Each code can be used once to sign in without your authenticator app.

nudge.title: Protect your account with two-factor login
nudge.bodyOwner: Add a code from your phone to every sign-in, so a stolen password is not enough to open your pharmacy.
nudge.bodyAdmin: Administrator accounts control every pharmacy. Add a code from your phone to every sign-in.

adminReset.title: Two-factor login
adminReset.hint: Turn it off if the user lost their phone and recovery codes. They will be signed out everywhere.
adminReset.confirm: Turn off two-factor login for {{name}} ({{email}})? They will be signed out of all devices.
adminReset.done: Two-factor login was turned off. The user can sign in with their password and set it up again.
adminReset.notEnabled: This user did not have two-factor login turned on.
